title: AID P065 — C3 Codex Raw Response
$comment: producer: Codex CLI (a DIFFERENT-provider process), consumer: aid-c3-dispatch.sh `verify` (a LATER EPIC). This is the RAW last-message Codex emits, BEFORE the bridge normalizes it into an audit_report artifact. Codex echoes `codex_brief_hash` (the sealed-brief hash it was given), NOT `input_manifest_hash` — that binding is bridge-filled during normalize. Top-level provenance keys (provider/model/process_id/input_manifest_hash) are added by the orchestrator and are FORBIDDEN here (additionalProperties:false). ⚠️ H1 TENSION (Step 1 empirical, codex-stream-sample/fields.md §`--output-schema empirical behavior`): the real Codex `--output-schema` flag forwards a schema to OpenAI as a strict structured-output response_format that REJECTS `if`/`then`/`else` with HTTP 400 ('if' is not permitted). THIS schema needs if/then for its conditional rules (status↔findings, unverifiable_reasons presence, action_owner-on-blocker), so it CANNOT be passed via --output-schema as-is. The conditional rules are load-bearing for post-hoc bridge validation and MUST NOT be dropped. A later EPIC that wires --output-schema must either NOT pass this schema, or split a permissive if/then-free subset for --output-schema while keeping THIS full schema as the trusted bridge-side validator. Do not weaken this schema to make it --output-schema-safe.

reviewed_head.$comment: the commit Codex reviewed; MUST equal the brief's head_sha (40-hex git sha).

codex_brief_hash.$comment: verbatim echo of the sealed-brief hash Codex was given. NOT input_manifest_hash (bridge-filled).

unverifiable_reasons.$comment: how the model reports 'no evidence' without inventing a field; conditionally required (see allOf).

blocking_findings.$comment: Codex asserts this; the bridge cross-checks blocking_findings == (∃ crit/high finding) in jq — JSON-Schema cannot express that cross-field arithmetic.

allOf.$comment: action_owner is REQUIRED when severity is critical or high; optional (but still enum-constrained) otherwise.
pass ⇒ no findings AND blocking_findings must be false.
